title: OAuth callback to / on a redirect-root brand returns 500 instead of redirecting to the newsroom
description: On the deployed CMS, GET / returns 307 to /newsroom but GET /?code=abc&state=xyz returns 500 (MarkusSiteRendererError: Site brand "pilobol-us" uses Markus renderer ... Next.js reader routes are not available) thrown from app/page.js via lib/site-renderer.ts. Cause: app/page.tsx skips the rootRoute redirect when hasOAuthRedirectParams is true, then falls through to getSiteRenderer(), which throws for Markus brands. Fix: for rootRoute kind redirect, always redirect to the destination preserving the query string so the Amplify OAuth listener on /newsroom completes sign-in; the reader path must never throw for a Markus brand (notFound instead). Add tests; update docs/site-stacks.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/135 (branch fix/PPY-92d4dc-oauth-root-redirect, not merged). CI green (python, ts, smoke). Root cause: app/page.tsx exempted OAuth params (code/state/error) from the rootRoute redirect, then fell through to getSiteRenderer(), which throws MarkusSiteRendererError, so plain / redirected (307) but /?code=&state= was 500. Fix: redirect roots always redirect with the query preserved (lib/root-route-redirect.ts); Markus brands reaching the reader path get notFound(). Test: npm run test:root-route-redirect (added to tests.yml). Note: current develop pilobol-us uses rootRoute newsroom at base path empty, so the deployed behavior reflects a redirect-root brand config; the fix covers any redirect-root brand.

right_now_summary: A fix redirects OAuth callbacks to the newsroom and prevents Markus brands from throwing errors.
